meta.name: The Rogue's Trial (TV Series)
meta.description: After 20 years missing, João Grilo returns to Taperoá to join his old friend Chicó and, after his story of resurrection spreads, he is disputed as an electoral candidate by the two most powerful politicians in the city. The four-chapter miniseries original version of O Auto da Compadecida 2.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After years away, João Grilo suddenly returns to Taperoá and discovers he’s become a local legend thanks to Chicó’s exaggerated stories. Fame hits fast, and trouble follows immediately.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: João Grilo starts using his reputation to get involved in local politics, playing both sides for his own benefit. New characters enter the chaos, and manipulation becomes the name of the game.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As João’s schemes grow bigger, conflicts explode across Taperoá, from political rivalries to romantic disputes. Chicó struggles to keep up while everything threatens to spiral out of control.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: João Grilo’s tricks finally catch up to him, leading to consequences that test his wit and morality once again. Humor, chaos, and justice collide in a classic Auto-style finale.
